SCENE sc_001 0-41500 EXT. BLACKWOOD COTTAGE RUINS – DAY
EP19:E1 0-4500 CAMERA: Full shot of Juliana and Alexander standing side by side amidst the charred, smoldering wreckage of their destroyed cottage, thick smoke rising behind them into the overcast sky.
EP19:E2 0-4500 ACTION: Juliana clutches her mother's scorched leather-bound herbal book against her chest, her face streaked with soot as she stares at the ruin in disbelief.
EP19:E3 1800-3500 JULIANA [Sorrowful, Hollow]: "This was our home."
EP19:E4 4500-9500 CAMERA: Close-up of the blackened, heat-damaged leather ledger held in Juliana's linen-bandaged hands.
EP19:E5 5100-8200 JULIANA [Emotional, Fragile]: "My mother's book almost burned with it."
EP19:E6 6500-9200 ACTION: Juliana tenderly lifts a scorched corner of parchment, revealing the surviving botanical drawing of medicinal herbs inside.
EP19:E7 9500-11800 CAMERA: Medium shot of Alexander looking down at Juliana with quiet, stoic concern.
EP19:E8 11800-15500 CAMERA: Medium shot of three villagers approaching through the burnt clearing: an elder villager carrying folded wool blankets, followed by a man and woman holding loaves of baked bread.
EP19:E9 12100-15200 ELDER VILLAGER [Respectful, Sincere]: "My lady. You cannot stay here."
EP19:E10 15500-18500 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's tearful, soot-stained face as she listens.
EP19:E11 16100-19000 ELDER VILLAGER [O.S.]: "There is an old barn near the village. It is empty."
EP19:E12 18500-20500 ACTION: The elder villager steps closer, resting a gentle, reassuring hand on Juliana's shoulder.
EP19:E13 19400-20400 ELDER VILLAGER [Gentle, Earnest]: "Take it."
EP19:E14 20600-22600 JULIANA [Hesitant, Humble]: "We cannot ask the village to feed us."
EP19:E15 23200-25200 ELDER VILLAGER [Warm, Grateful]: "You saved my son's life."
EP19:E16 25800-28200 CAMERA: Close-up of the elder villager's rough, weathered hands offering a fresh loaf of artisan bread wrapped in cloth against the smoking timber ruins.
EP19:E17 26400-27800 ELDER VILLAGER [O.S.]: "You saved mine, too."
EP19:E18 28200-30800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana, tears spilling down her cheeks as she smiles through her grief.
EP19:E19 28500-29800 JULIANA [Whispering, Tearful]: "Thank you."
EP19:E20 30800-34500 ACTION: Alexander steps forward and accepts the thick folded blankets and a wooden bucket from the villager.
EP19:E21 31200-33200 ALEXANDER [Deep, Solemn]: "We will not forget this kindness."
EP19:E22 33300-34800 ELDER VILLAGER [Nodding, Earnest]: "Neither will the village."
EP19:E23 34800-38200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Juliana looking back one last time at the devastated doorway of her ruined sanctuary, hugging the ledger tightly.
EP19:E24 35500-37400 JULIANA [Choked Up, Mournful]: "Goodbye, Blackwood."
EP19:E25 38000-41500 ACTION: Juliana turns her back on the ruins. Wide tracking shot from behind as Alexander and Juliana walk side by side down the stone path, leaving the smoldering ash behind as the scene fades into black.
SCENE sc_002 41500-89500 EXT. MISTY DEEP WOODS – DAY
EP19:E26 41500-44200 CAMERA: Medium shot tracking Alexander from behind as he stands waiting beside a moss-covered ancient tree trunk in the dense, fog-laden forest.
EP19:E27 43000-46000 ACTION: A bald, scarred man dressed in a dark coat emerges from between the trees, immediately coming to a halt and bowing with clasped hands in formal deference.
EP19:E28 44300-45800 INFORMANT [Subservient, Urgent]: "Your Grace."
EP19:E29 46000-49200 CAMERA: Medium close-up of Alexander turning toward his operative, his eyes dark with calculating authority.
EP19:E30 47100-49200 ALEXANDER [Authoritative, Direct]: "Tell me what is happening in Ashburg."
EP19:E31 49500-54800 INFORMANT [Grave, Cautious]: "Lord Sterling's influence has grown since your disappearance. He has men in the county offices, the courts, even among the household staff."
EP19:E32 55300-61400 CAMERA: Slow push-in on Alexander's rugged, scarred face, his jaw tightening with simmering rage as he listens.
EP19:E33 55300-61300 INFORMANT [O.S.]: "Rupert has become the face of Ashburg. He sits in your father's room, signs your estate papers, gives orders as though the title already belongs to him."
EP19:E34 61400-64800 CAMERA: Medium shot of the bald informant standing among the towering trees, reporting solemnly.
EP19:E35 61600-64800 INFORMANT [Earnest]: "And Lady Catherine, she behaves as though she is already the future duchess."
EP19:E36 64800-70600 CAMERA: Close-up of the informant, his voice dropping into urgent, discreet concern.
EP19:E37 65100-70500 INFORMANT [Whispering, Alarmed]: "But they have separated her from the household. She is watched constantly. Every letter she sends is checked. Every visitor is questioned."
EP19:E38 70600-73300 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's right hand clenching into a powerful, trembling fist at his coat seam, veins bulging with restrained violence.
EP19:E39 70900-73200 INFORMANT [O.S.]: "There are almost no loyal servants left around her."
EP19:E40 73300-76200 CAMERA: Low-angle shot past Alexander toward the informant.
EP19:E41 73500-76400 INFORMANT [Grave]: "The people who served your family for years have been dismissed, frightened away, or replaced."
EP19:E42 76200-78800 ACTION: Alexander lifts his gaze toward the cold forest canopy, his breathing heavy with profound anguish.
EP19:E43 76500-78800 ALEXANDER [Cold, Pained Fury]: "My mother is a prisoner in her own house."
EP19:E44 78800-81200 CAMERA: Close-up of the informant looking steadily at Alexander.
EP19:E45 79000-81000 INFORMANT [Quiet, Solemn]: "And everyone believes you are dead."
EP19:E46 81200-83800 CAMERA: Extreme close-up of Alexander's scarred eye and grimly set mouth.
EP19:E47 81500-83700 ALEXANDER [Lethal, Calculating]: "Then let them believe it a little longer."
EP19:E48 84000-85500 INFORMANT [Inquiring, Tense]: "And when we have the proof?"
EP19:E49 85500-89500 CAMERA: Dramatic low-angle push-in on Alexander's commanding silhouette, his combat scar etched sharply against the fog.
EP19:E50 85900-88900 ALEXANDER [Vow of Vengeance, Resolute]: "Then Ashburg will remember who it belongs to."
SCENE sc_003 89500-119630 INT. ABANDONED BARN – NIGHT
EP19:E51 89500-94000 CAMERA: Wide atmospheric shot of the shadowy barn loft. Moonlight filters through vertical wooden slats, illuminating Juliana seated on a pile of straw beside a warm, glowing kerosene lantern.
EP19:E52 94000-96800 CAMERA: Over-the-shoulder close-up of Juliana's bandaged hands tracing the detailed botanical drawing on the charred page of her mother's herbal.
EP19:E53 96800-97800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana's face, silent tears streaming down her soot-smudged cheeks as her chin quivers.
EP19:E54 97200-100000 ACTION: The heavy wooden barn doors creak open. Alexander steps into the lantern light, carrying a bundle of firewood and a thick blanket under his arm.
EP19:E55 97400-99400 JULIANA [O.S.]: "We have lost everything."
EP19:E56 99900-103000 CAMERA: Medium shot of Juliana breaking down in tears over her open book, struggling to breathe through her weeping.
EP19:E57 100400-102600 JULIANA [Despairing, Broken]: "I don't know what we will do tomorrow."
EP19:E58 103000-106000 ACTION: Alexander steps up behind her and gently drapes the thick woolen blanket over her trembling shoulders, resting his hands reassuringly on her.
EP19:E59 104200-106200 ALEXANDER [Soft, Steadfast]: "Tomorrow, we begin again."
EP19:E60 106000-109800 CAMERA: Close-up of Juliana turning her tear-drenched eyes up toward Alexander, her face filled with longing and newfound hope.
EP19:E61 107300-109200 JULIANA [Faint Smile, Emotional]: "You make it sound so simple."
EP19:E62 109800-112500 ACTION: Alexander sits down beside her in the straw. Juliana leans gently against his shoulder, letting her weary head rest against his broad chest.
EP19:E63 112500-119630 CAMERA: Slow cinematic push-in on the couple nestled together in the warm lantern glow. Alexander wraps his arm firmly around Juliana as she closes her eyes in exhausted relief, while his piercing gaze stares resolutely into the darkness, determined to reclaim everything that was stolen.
